rendering_review: All three operators, region axes, direction arrows, gate context, flags and non-admission wording are readable. No speed units or length values are claimed.

observations.mean-of-24-SON-fields: Every kernel switches between a southern western band and a northern eastern band near the central region; the connection is deliberately absent.
observations.provider-year-1994: Smoothing reduces small jumps but preserves a large central band switch; raw operator also touches the northern search edge.
observations.provider-year-1997: Multiple separated selections persist after smoothing. A northern/western and a southern/eastern core are not one established continuous axis.
observations.provider-year-2015: The core selector switches between the northwestern branch and a southern eastern band. Smoothing alone does not establish the connecting route.
observations.provider-year-2016: Smoothing preserves a central discontinuity despite the less pronounced regional bend. No connecting segment was fabricated.

next_method_rationale: Test a separately frozen model-flow-following path, with declared seeds, interpolation, integration accuracy and loop/weak-flow/exit failures. A seed-defined model streamline is a different evidence class, not automatically a physical current axis.
